physics.amplitude_fit: Kamaretsos 1107.0854 Eqs31-34 at 10 remnant M after 22 luminosity peak
physics.relative_mode_phases: m*orbital_phase; simplified coherent convention, not NR-fitted
physics.numerical_ringup: PyCBC taper=True, short tau/10 pre-reference ringup; t>=0 amplitude unchanged; not an IMR model

crop_rule: segment placement from supplied gap start with seeded local gap start 132..263; parent gap population is near injected peak; no outcome exclusion
scope: finite 528-s two-channel segments; no claim of recovering the full longest ringdown
mask_semantics: 1 suppresses signal; noise remains inside gap; not missing spacecraft samples
selection: unmaximized joint A/E mean PSD mismatch on validation only
test_policy: no test target read until both raw/white training checkpoints are selected; retain all 6000 rows
cwt: Morlet magnitude and phase of input divided by observed-input channel RMS; no target feature
noise_psd: 512 independent pure-noise crops, rectangular window; diagonal finite-crop metric, not full correlated likelihood
parent_train_attribute_note: early train config lacks numerical_ringup key; six stored rows including prefix boundary reproduce current frozen simulator bitwise
training_loss: identical physical-space loss for raw/white; joint direct PSD mismatch + 0.5 PSD relative squared error + 0.5 time/gap relative squared error; numerical guards 1e-12 in calibrated working units; no evaluation floor
